turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
If. Was he heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
I'm not doing your file for you. Nobody called me before that zero went in; Owen read it on his phone in class. Start there.
